title: Probing Spurious Correlations in Popular Event-Based Rumor Detection Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on event-mixed random data splits versus event-separated splits to measure the models' reliance on event-specific keywords and intra-event textual similarity.

Training simple classifiers solely on source-specific metadata features (user interaction count and time range) to demonstrate how data source propagation patterns artificially predict veracity labels.
Analyzing dataset instances to identify noise where broad event-level fact-checking annotations assign incorrect veracity labels to specific, individual microblog posts.
